settings.heading: Our Story
settings.text:
Royal Gifts began with a simple idea - to transform ordinary gifts into meaningful keepsakes.

We noticed that most home decor lacked personalization and emotional value. So we started crafting custom nameplates, metal wall decor, and personalized gifts that reflect each customer's story.

Today, Royal Gifts proudly delivers handcrafted products across India, combining modern design with traditional craftsmanship.
